heading: Three new Jharkhand HC judges to take oath on Sept 23 | Ranchi News - The Times of India
author: Chandrajit Mukherjee / TNN /  Sep 21, 2026, 21:43 IST
paragraphs: Ranchi: Three members of the state judiciary – Manoj Prasad, Akhil Kumar, and Ram Sharma – would take the oath of office as judges of the Jharkhand high court on September 23

Chief Justice MS Sonak would administer the oath to the newly appointed judges on the premises of the Jharkhand high court.President Draupadi Murmu, had on September 19, approved the appointments of the three former district court judges as the Jharkhand HC judges
A notification to this effect was issued by the Union ministry of law and justice.Stay updated with the latest Ranchi news
